newsitem.title: USA: Read-Rite rejects Applied Magnetics offer.
newsitem.headline: Read-Rite rejects Applied Magnetics offer.

text.p: Read-Rite Corp said Monday it has rejected an unsolicited takeover bid from Applied Magnetics Corp.

Read-Rite said in a statement its board of directors voted unanimously to reject the offer and concluded that remaining an independent company was the best opportunity for Read-Rite's shareholders, employees and customers.

"Read-Rite's independence has been critical to its success to date, and we are confident that adherence to our existing, long-term strategic business plan will enable us to deliver further value to our shareholders, employees, customers, suppliers, and the company's other constituencies in the future," said Cyril Yansouni, chairman and chief executive officer. "For this fundamental reason, Read-Rite's board of directors has rejected Applied Magnetics' unsolicited proposal."
In February Applied Magnetics offered Read-Rite shareholders 0.679 Applied Magnetics shares for each Read-Rite share held.
Read-Rite said it has retained Goldman, Sachs & Co as its independent financial advisor.
Read-Rite and Applied are makers of computer disk drive parts.
